notes: En grupos de 3 te darán dos temas para discutir.
Es una conversación entre tú y tus compañeros; el profesor no participa.

items: I think / I believe that …
In my opinion, …
Personally, I feel that …
If you ask me, …
The way I see it, …
I totally agree with you.
That's a good point.
Exactly! / Absolutely!
I was going to say the same thing.
You're right about that.
I see your point, but …
I'm not so sure about that.
I'm afraid I disagree.
That's true, but on the other hand …
I partly agree, but …

phrases.group: Dar el turno / incluir a otros
items: What do you think, [name]?
Do you agree with that?
What about you?
How about your experience?
Sorry, what do you mean by …?
Could you say that again, please?
Do you mean that …?
Could you give an example?
That reminds me of …
Speaking of …, …
Another thing is that …
Let's move on to the next question.
So, to sum up, we think that …
That's an interesting question …
Let me think …
Well, it depends on …
I've never thought about that, but …
What would you do in your free time as a child?
What did you use to like to eat when you were younger?
What didn't you use to like to do when you were a child?
What do you usually do in your free time now?
What are you used to doing at the weekend?
questions.note: En el PPT dice "did you used to" y "didn't you used to"; la forma correcta es "did you use to" / "didn't you use to" (después de did, sin -d).

items: "The average life expectancy of Colombians will be higher in 20 years." To what extent do you agree or disagree?
"The rise of streaming services like Spotify and Apple Music mean that 'physical' music will disappear in the future." To what extent do you agree or disagree?
Have you ever sprained your ankle or burnt yourself? What happened?
What do you usually do when you feel under the weather?
Should doctors prescribe fewer painkillers? Why or why not?
Is it easy to get a sick note in Colombia? Should it be easier or harder?
Did your grandparents use to have healthier habits than people today?
Are you used to doing exercise every week? Why or why not?
Should healthcare be free for everyone? Who should pay for it?
Is private health insurance necessary in Colombia?
Should the government follow stricter guidelines on junk food and sugar?
Should counselling be free for all students?
What can the government do to increase life expectancy?
Do you think doctors will be replaced by artificial intelligence?
What will you be doing this time next year?
What are you doing this weekend? (plans)
Will people live to 120 in the future?
Will physical books, CDs or cinemas disappear?
